Welcome all to v/SavageGods! In this subverse you are a god. If you are new here join in on the fun.

Becoming a God
The first thing you need to do to play is to make a post claiming your godhood. Make sure to put [New God] in the post title, followed by your god's name. The body of the post should then contain your god's domain. In this, think of greek mythology; there was a god of the sea, dead, love, war, etc. You can be as specific or broad with your domain as you like. This does not limit your actions, but should be a good guide line. (e.g. if you are a god of the sea, you are not forbidden to come onto land or start a tribe in the desert, but you may want to try to stick with the 'sea' theme as much as possible - like buildings made of coral.) Your first post can include a bit of fluff about your god if you like, but claiming a domain is all that needs to be said.

Creations
We are currently in the age of creation. Any creative action you take will succeed, any other action will need to be voted upon (see 'God actions' for more details). Creations can include worlds, realms, races, avatars of your god, monsters, animals, plants, mountains, rivers, etc. Other actions, like declaring war or the outright destruction of something needs to be voted on like all other god actions. There will be different ages throughout the game and during each age certain actions will always succeed or have a higher chance of succeeding.

On Races
Races can be created by any god and they don't necessarily need to fit with that god's domain. However, any god can control a race once created. So if God A creates bat-people, gods B, C, and D are allowed to send them to war, help invent technology, find cults, etc. Remember that the point here is to create a story of this world - not be the strongest race/god. This rule applies to other creations like monsters or spirits of the world as well - unless a god specifically states they are avatars of their god. Avatars are worldly embodiment of Gods and are solely under a god's control.

I would personally love to see more unique races and monsters in this world - aren't we all just a little sick of the same Tolkien rip-offs (elves, orcs, dwarves, etc)?

God actions
A godâ€™s action is exactly what it sounds like and its success depends on the amount of upvotes received, thus voting is very important here. If a post has more upvotes, it is successful, more downvotes it fails (the percentage of both will play a crucial role as well). There are ways around this, but this will be the case for most actions. Also, if a post receives no votes at all it is up to me(@middle_path) to decide what happens. When a god action is made, you can comment, but must comment in character (your chosen god). If you choose not to be in character in either a post or comment, add the tag [Meta]. Votes are counted and set in stone after the 5 day mark, any votes made after this time will not count towards the action success rate.

e.g. Poseidon decides he wants to flood a city. He posts â€œ[Disaster] Flood Lesbosâ€ he receives 7 upvotes and 3 downvotes, giving him a success rate of 70%. This means his flood was a success, but not a total annihilation. Roughly 70% of the city has become water logged and flooded, while some high ground remained dry.

Council
Certain posts can be tagged with [Council]. These will be discussions between gods to determine something. If the god proposing the council has a direct question (e.g. Should we have fire in this world?) the post with the most upvotes is the determining answer. However, if it is just a discussion, we will have to feel it out.

As this is a free-form roleplaying game there does need to be final say in some things, especially to keep players from going on power trips. I will be that determining factor. Worry not, I am a kind god. ;)
